messages:
incidents-bot: [ALERT] GPU OOM spike detected in eu-west-1-gpu-pool — 12 container restarts in the last 5m for svc-inference-prod. P95 latency increased. Pager: lina (oncall). Link: https://internal.incidents/1778881234

lina (oncall): ACKing. creating incident channel #inc-1778881234. tagging SRE/Runtime.

raj (sre): grabbing logs now. can someone run: `kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=svc-inference-prod -o wide` and `kubectl logs <pod> -c runtime --tail=200`? I want the OOM stacktrace.

sam (eng-runtime): paste from a recent pod log:
```
[2026-03-17T02:20:41Z] ERROR runtime: process killed: signal 9
[2026-03-17T02:20:41Z] runtime: cuda:0: failed to alloc 3.2 GiB: out of memory
[2026-03-17T02:20:41Z] prefill: tokens=12500, model=redwood-7B-ctx64k-q4_0
[2026-03-17T02:20:41Z] container restarted by OOM-killer
```
Looks like very long prefill requests (12.5k tokens) are exhausting GPU VRAM + KV cache -> container kill.

raj (sre): that matches the node OOM summary: `kubelet: eviction, memory.available < threshold` on gpu-node-34. Any recent deploys?

sam (eng-runtime): no deploys in last hour. Probable cause: a customer sent a single request with very large context and we don't cap prefill tokens per-request on this public route. Suggestions: 1) Emergency throttle the public endpoint to max_prefill_tokens=4096 2) Enable coldmodel fallback for >8k prefill 3) Drop prefix caching for risky routes.

carla (infra): I'm going to cordon gpu-node-34 and drain the pods to stop flapping. Doing `kubectl cordon gpu-node-34 && kubectl drain gpu-node-34 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`. Will move affected pods to other nodes while we patch config.

lina (oncall): please post which customers are impacted — need to notify CS. kevin?

kevin (support): quick query against telemetry: two heavy requests from customer_acme and customer_beta in the last 10m hitting that route. Both lowered availability for ~3-5% of their calls. No full outages but elevated error rates and retries. I'll draft a customer note: "We observed increased errors due to extremely large single-request contexts; mitigation in progress."

sam (eng-runtime): rolling an emergency config patch now. patch payload (curl):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://config.internal/api/v1/limits" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","max_prefill_tokens":4096,"enable_cold_fallback":true}'
```
I'll roll to 10% canary first.

raj (sre): while canary rolls, we should enable fast-fallback policy in the router to route >8k token requests to the smaller-capacity, non-GPU coldmodel pool: `route.policy.prefill_token_limit=8192 -> pool:coldmodel`. Can someone push that?

sam (eng-runtime): on it. pushing router change now.

carla (infra): node cordon/drain succeeded. moving 6 pods off gpu-node-34. scaling up gpu-pool by +2 nodes temporarily: `terraform apply -var 'scale_delta=2'` in progress.

lina (oncall): status update?

raj (sre): after cordon/drain + router patch + config canary, restart rate dropped from 12/min to 1-2/min. CPU/Memory headroom recovering on the pool.

kevin (support): sending initial customer update to Acme & Beta: "Mitigations active; short term throttling applied; we'll follow up with a post-incident report." Want me to include an ETA?

maria (ps): include recommendation for customers to chunk very large contexts or use batch/streaming; we'll follow up with engineering guidance.

sam (eng-runtime): canary looks good at 10%. Promoting to 100% now. Also enabled `prefill.max_tokens` enforcement at nginx layer to reject >16k with 413, and at app layer to reject >12k (higher strictness at app).

raj (sre): monitoring: OOM counts trending to 0 over last 3m. alert thresholds silenced for this incident.

lina (oncall): action items for postmortem: 1) add per-route defensive caps 2) add prefill token circuit-breaker 3) add synthetic test for long-context prefill 4) improve customer-facing rate limits and docs. Assigning owners: sam -> runtime caps, raj -> circuit breaker + monitoring, carla -> autoscale playbook, kevin/maria -> customer comms.

kevin (support): sent customer notes. Acme confirmed reduced errors and appreciate the quick update.

sam (eng-runtime): logs: `SIGKILL` origin confirmed as kernel OOM for prefill allocation; we'll add a telemetry flag to correlate very large prefill requests to future incidents.

maria (ps): schedule follow-up postmortem meeting tomorrow 10:00 UTC. I'll produce a short summary for customers afterwards.

lina (oncall): incident moving to "mitigated". keep watch for 1h. good job team.

incidents-bot: Incident 1778881234: state changed to MITIGATED by lina (oncall). duration 18m.

sam (eng-runtime): quick note: patch to block >12k prefill persisted. We'll open a PR to make route defaults safer by default.

raj (sre): marking for postmortem. saving core dumps and GPU trace logs to s3://incidents/1778881234/ for debug.

kevin (support): final customer update sent: "Mitigation complete; no further action required. Postmortem to follow."

lina (oncall): closing channel in 1h unless new signal. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
